Subject: Post-demo recap & asks — HelixMed evaluation

Hi Laura,

Thanks for joining the demo today. Quick recap and a few asks to keep momentum:

- Goal: validate technical fit and procurement path so we can get a mutual action plan in place
- Key open questions:
  * Who is the economic buyer for this initiative (name + title)?
  * Who owns security/infosec evidence intake (SOC2, pen test redaction, audit logs)?
  * Procurement timeline: estimated committee review and PO signature target
  * Any regulatory/data-residency constraints we should be aware of

Attached: HelixMed_SOC2_questions.xlsx — it's a short checklist that maps to the artifacts you asked for.

Proposed next steps:
1) You share stakeholder names and procurement contact by EOD Tue (9/3)
2) We deliver SOC2 summary + redacted pen test within 5 business days of stakeholder confirmation
3) Technical deep dive with your security team (30–45m) — Marcus can lead

Marcus Lin (SE) and Priyom Das (Sales) are copied for support. Laura — let me know if the proposed cadence works and if procurement needs a sample contract or SOW.

Thanks,

Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0181

Hi Stephanie,

Appreciate the recap — helpful.

Quick answers:
- Economic buyer: Mark Wallace, VP of Product (mark.wallace@helixmed.com)
- Security lead: Priya Rao, Director InfoSec (security_contact@helixmed.com)
- Procurement lead: procurement@helixmed.com (team lead: Ana Morales)
- Timeline: We have a review slot on Sept 15th; target to have an approved vendor and PO by Sept 30th
- Data residency: Production data must remain in us-east-1; some PHI elements require encryption at rest + audit trail

We'll need:
- Redacted SOC2 report (or SOC2 type II summary)
- Pen-test executive summary (we can't accept raw reports without NDA)
- Audit log schema and retention policy

I'll loop Ana from procurement — she may post an RFI.

Laura

Hi all,

Quick tech clarifications:
- Region lock: we can pin compute and storage to us-east-1 for dedicated/private deployments; for hosted, we have a us-east-1 region option and can provide controls to restrict replicas.
- Audit logs: we capture request-level logs (request ID, api_key_id, timestamp, model, tokens_in/tokens_out, response status). Default retention is 90 days; we can extend to 365 days via a configurable retention policy with S3 lifecycle rules.
- PHI: data-in-transit is TLS; at-rest uses AES-256. For PHI workflows, we recommend dedicated capacity or Private deployment (VPC) — happy to document specifics.

I can run the 30–45m security deep dive. Available Sept 4 at 10:00 or Sept 5 at 14:00 PT.

Attaching: redacted_pen_test_summary.pdf (we will provide redacted variant once NDA is signed) and a short audit-log-schema.pdf

— Marcus
